name: superpower
description: Gives Claude Code the client's business context (processes, rules, stakeholders) and asks real employees via Dial phone calls when a business rule is missing.

api_url.title: Superpower API URL
api_url.description: Base URL of the Superpower service that places Dial clarification calls (and serves knowledge unless Knowledge URL is set).

knowledge_url.title: Knowledge backend URL (optional)
knowledge_url.description: Base URL of the team's company-knowledge backend (serves GET /knowledge). Leave empty to use the Superpower API URL.

api_token.title: Superpower API token
api_token.description: Shared bearer token for the Superpower service.

engagement_id.title: Engagement ID
engagement_id.description: Which client engagement this machine works on. All knowledge and calls are scoped to it.

engineer_name.title: Your name
engineer_name.description: Said on clarification calls: 'calling on behalf of <your name>'.
